LVP Flooring Cost Huntsville AL: 2026 Pricing & Installation Guide

Planning to install luxury vinyl plank (LVP) flooring in your Huntsville, Alabama home?

LVP flooring costs typically range from $3–8 per square foot for materials and $2–5 for professional installation labor,

depending on quality, thickness, and your specific location in North Alabama.

At 2M Construction LLC, we help Huntsville and Madison homeowners choose the right LVP product and budget accurately

before starting your project. Here's what you need to know about LVP pricing in 2026.

LVP Flooring Cost Breakdown: What You'll Pay in Huntsville, AL

LVP flooring is one of the most affordable premium flooring options available today.

In Huntsville and surrounding areas (Madison, Harvest, Meridianville),

total project costs depend on three main factors: material cost, installation labor, and subfloor preparation.

Material Costs: Budget $3–8 per square foot for luxury vinyl plank itself.

Budget vinyl (0.8–1mm wear layer) costs $1.50–$3/sq ft, while premium brands with enhanced durability

(2–3mm wear layer, authentic wood grain) run $4–8/sq ft.
